priorBlockers: All three round-three reproductions now preserve the expected qualification and ownership. Prior routing/list/validation cases remain corrected in inspected probes.

findings.title: Do not let child qualification overwrite recomputed frame-limit status
findings.inputExpression: ['## Hypothesis ' + 'x'.repeat(2380), '', '- Notes', '', '  ## Details', '', '  The case is silver.']
findings.reason: qualify computes unresolved when the added outer frame exceeds its cap, then spreads selected, which is a complete child qualification carrying status qualified. That overwrites the new status and exposes nonfactual content without the governing frame. Copy only meaning fields, or set computed status after the spread.
